notes.note: Reviewed the deployed route composition. Directory search preserves arrays and distinguishes provider rejection with 503 and a correlation ID. The Project history compatibility leaf returns a typed unavailable response when admitted, without reading unbound file-memory records. Existing Project channel and Task room routes remain the supported scoped reads.
Reviewed the auth users search command through the shared selected-Station request path. Successful arrays print as JSON and unavailable directory errors preserve the server response status and code.

Reviewed the public Project conversation read and query consumer. A successful array, including an empty array, is returned unchanged. Refusals and invalid bodies reject through StationHttpError, keeping server metadata. The shipped Project page uses the separate scoped room UI.

Reviewed the mounted Project page and conversation list. Project channels and Task rooms have separate query loading, error and retry state; a failed list cannot create the empty placeholder. The obsolete file-memory read no longer backs the page.

Reviewed shared Knowledge fetcher envelopes, including valid void successes. It forwards observed status and server error metadata with the common helper and preserves deadline failures. The Project conversation read validates its returned array.

Reviewed the Project-conversation SDK reader. It keeps the published call signature and requires a successful array. Selected Station transport remains shared and returns typed refusal or response errors rather than empty success.

Reviewed the mounted people directory branch and shared runtime error response. Empty searches still return 200 arrays. A provider failure becomes a bounded 503 with a public code and correlation ID and a sanitized server log. Other auth, users and badge-photo leaves remain intact.

Reviewed the mounted authority checks: account-bound device transport keeps its existing 403, an admitted operator read gets a typed 503, and the legacy adapter is never queried. Existing shared Task and Project Room fixtures remain in scope.

Reviewed the only runtime route delta. The legacy Project conversations leaf no longer reads unbound file-memory data or emits an empty success when unavailable. It reports a fixed typed refusal after existing admission. Account-bound transport policy, principal resolution and all other mounts, including the photographed sign-in and step-up journeys, remain the same.
